validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml"
       xmlns:event="https://github.com/stateforward/scxml.rs/namespaces/event"
       version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="idle">
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order" target="done"
                event:schema='{"type": "object", "required": [id]}'/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the inline schema of `<transition>` is not JSON: invalid JSON at line 1, column 33: expected value
notes: an `event:schema` value whose first non-white-space character is `{` (or that is exactly `true` or `false`) is the schema's JSON text; any other value is a reference to a JSON file relative to the document
diagnostics.help: write the schema as UTF-8 JSON; in a double-quoted XML attribute write `"` as `"`, or quote the attribute with `'`
spec_references: RFC 8259 The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
